name: Erythroid differentiation with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover primitive/definitive erythrocyte differentiation, erythroid transcription and red cell modules, while the heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport members are what the other erythropoiesis themes lack.

core: Cell death after loss of survival cues
qualifier: absent dependence-receptor ligand or matrix attachment
name: Cell death upon loss of ligand or matrix attachment
rationale: Members concern apoptosis triggered by unliganded dependence receptors (NTRK3), anoikis, involution and developmental death, unlike the p75NTR/neurotrophin and apoptotic-execution confusables.

qualifier: VEGF and FGF production and response
name: Endothelial angiogenic regulation via VEGF and FGF signaling
rationale: Members regulate endothelial proliferation, apoptosis, activation, migration and tube formation alongside VEGF and FGF production and signaling, in both directions, unlike the purely pro- or anti-sprouting and vessel-remodeling confusables.

name: Antibacterial sensing by TLR2/4/5 and NOD1/2 receptors
rationale: Members detect bacterial LPS, lipopeptides, peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide via TLR2/4/5 (MyD88/IRAK4) and NOD1/2, distinct from TRIF/TLR3, inflammasome-cytokine and monocyte TLR confusables.

qualifier: neural plate and axial mesoderm specification
name: Neural plate, axial mesoderm and dorsoventral axis specification
rationale: Members specify the neural plate, its border and neural crest, notochord/floor plate and the dorsoventral axis, lacking the hindbrain, planar-polarity convergent extension and spinal cord neuron programs of confusables.

qualifier: retinal neurons, photoreceptors, lens and anterior eye
name: Eye development: retinal neurons, photoreceptors and lens
rationale: Members cover morphogenesis of retina, optic cup, lens, cornea, iris and eyelid plus photoreceptor and retinal neuron development, unlike the phototransduction/retinoid, retinal vasculature and optic nerve confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface proteins
name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface protein signatures
rationale: Members are surface-marker modules of resting/activated dendritic cells, monocytes, T and plasma cells, distinct from MHC II antigen processing and monocyte receptor confusables.

qualifier: NFE2L2 and p53 regulation of NADPH metabolism
name: NFE2L2 and p53 control of redox and NADPH metabolism
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target programs and turnover with p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation of pentose phosphate, NADP+ and glycolysis, unlike the FOXO and HIF hypoxia confusables.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism and molybdenum cofactor synthesis
rationale: Members cover cysteine/transsulfuration, sulfide oxidation and alkanesulfonate metabolism plus molybdenum cofactor (sulfite oxidase) synthesis, which the selenium, glutathione and vitamin B6 confusables lack.

name: E2F target transcription and DREAM repression at G1/S
rationale: Members are E2F target and G1/S transcription programs including DREAM and p107/p130-HDAC1 repression, which distinguish it from RB/CDK4/6, G2/M and replication-licensing confusables.

qualifier: insulin secretion, adipogenesis and lipid storage
name: Insulin secretion, adipogenesis and lipid storage in energy homeostasis
rationale: Members span islet hormone secretion, insulin signaling, adipocyte differentiation, thermogenesis, triglyceride and lipid droplet handling and their nuclear-receptor control, unlike the glycogenolysis, phospholipid and glycerol confusables.

name: Proximal insulin/IGF1 receptor signaling via IRS and SHC
rationale: Members cover IRS and SHC/SOS activation, AKT2, signal attenuation and regulation of glycogen synthesis and glucose import, lacking the GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin members of confusables.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor control of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte lineages
name: Colony-stimulating factor control of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and myeloid dendritic differentiation through M-CSF, G-CSF and GM-CSF signaling, unlike the erythroid/megakaryocytic and interleukin/bone-marrow confusables.

name: Atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitin activation and atypical or branched chain formation with USP and metalloprotease DUBs, unlike the proteasomal, ERAD, Fanconi and OTU-deubiquitination confusables.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S, origin licensing and DNA damage checkpoints
name: E2F-driven cell cycle, origin licensing and G2/M checkpoints
rationale: Members cover E2F/RB G1/S control, ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex licensing, replication and G2 DNA damage checkpoints and G2/M entry, lacking the APC/C, spindle, cytokinesis and meiotic content of confusables.

core: Retroviral life cycle and host restriction
qualifier: APOBEC3 cytidine editing and retroelement silencing
name: Retroviral replication and host restriction by APOBEC3 and silencing
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration, viral transcription and latency, and host restriction by APOBEC3 C-to-U editing and HUSH/KRAB-ZFP retroelement silencing, unlike immunoglobulin diversification and A-to-I editing confusables.

qualifier: glucuronate-xylulose pathway and its inborn errors
name: Fructose and glucuronate-xylulose catabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism and the glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate pathway with fructosuria, fructose intolerance and pentosuria, unlike the non-oxidative pentose phosphate and galactose confusables.

core: Membrane potential regulation by K+ and Na+ transport
name: Two-pore leak K+ channels and resting membrane potential
rationale: Members are TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK and Ca2+-activated K+ channels with regulation of resting potential, hyperpolarization and Na+ transport, unlike the KATP, cation-chloride cotransporter and P-type ATPase confusables.

name: Acetylcholine, serotonin and tachykinin receptor control of gut motility
rationale: Members are muscarinic, serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling with gastric motility, acid secretion and intestinal smooth muscle contraction, unlike the generic smooth muscle, cAMP/PDE and histamine confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle sarcomere function and calcineurin-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover sarcomeric filament assembly, contraction, stretch detection, atrophy/growth and calcineurin-NFAT phosphatase signaling, unlike the dystrophin/NMJ, myoblast and cardiac adaptation confusables.

qualifier: transcription factor and RNA-binding protein targets
name: SUMO conjugation-deconjugation cycle and transcription factor SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins, while confusables are SUMOylation of DNA repair, replication and nuclear envelope targets.

name: Photoreceptor differentiation and outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members cover rod, cone and bipolar development with photoreceptor outer segment and ciliary transition zone protein targeting, unlike general cilium trafficking and whole-eye morphogenesis confusables.

name: Glial activation in amyloid-beta and tau pathology
rationale: Members regulate microglial and astrocyte activation, amyloid-beta formation/clearance and neurofibrillary tangles, whose glial-activation component distinguishes it from amyloid clearance and fibril confusables.

name: Mitochondrial valine/isoleucine catabolism and metabolite repair
rationale: Members cover valine/isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism defects, biotin metabolism and 2-hydroxyglutarate metabolite repair, unlike the leucine-catabolism disorder confusables.

name: p53 transcriptional control of intrinsic apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members are p53 expression, cofactor control and transcription of death genes (PUMA, caspases, death receptors) and p21/G1 arrest, unlike the ARF/p16 senescence, BH3-only and DNA-damage-checkpoint confusables.
